summary: Frontend-only regression on Projeto Urso iteration 2 (quick-check, floating tab bar, categorized shopping list, Estatísticas screen). All 4 features validated on mobile viewport 390x844 via Expo web preview. 100% of requested testIDs present and interactive flows working: meal card check toggle increments/decrements daily-progress-count (0/6 → 1/6 → 0/6), open-stats-btn and ajustes-stats-shortcut both route to /estatisticas, stats-back-btn returns, all 4 counter cards + streak-card + current-streak render, 7 category blocks render in Compras with collapsible headers (collapsing Proteínas hid its 4 items) and item check persists on the global counter (0/21 → 1/21). Tab bar is confirmed floating pill: computed style position=absolute, bottom=12px, left=12px, right=12px, width=366px (< 390 viewport), borderRadius=999px. Screen content padding accounts for tab bar height. Minor: React Native Web console warning "shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow" from tab bar shadow* props in (tabs)/_layout.tsx — cosmetic only.

react_native_issues.issue: Uses deprecated shadow* props (shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset). RN Web logs deprecation warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:38-41

action_items: Optional: replace deprecated shadow* props in (tabs)/_layout.tsx with boxShadow for RN Web compatibility (cosmetic warning, does not affect functionality).
critical_code_review_comments: computeStats currentStreak logic: when today is incomplete but yesterday is complete, streak starts at 0 (i=0 skipped) and iterates back correctly; verified visually with 0/0 streak on fresh data.
MealCard uses inner Pressable for check button and calls e.stopPropagation to avoid triggering parent Pressable navigation — good pattern.
Both open-stats-btn (Hoje) and ajustes-stats-shortcut (Ajustes) route via router.push('/estatisticas'), giving two entry points as required.
seed_data_creation: Reused pre-seeded 'Projeto Urso — Dieta b...' plan (6 meals) that was already active from prior iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 2 features fully validated. Active plan has 6 meals and 21 aggregated shopping items across 7 categories. Estatísticas empty state renders correctly with 0 counters and empty bar chart when no consumption entries exist for the day.
